'''Sebaracca''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] entrepreneur and the owner and manager of [[Club 111]], a drinking and dancing venue in the city of [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], in the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Genarius]]. She was commonly in her bar or dancing in the floor, trying to ensure that everyone was having fun and spending money.

Sebaracca had two hired Wookiee porters, [[Bael]] and [[Touda]], who exercised her the right to refuse admission. Bael and Touda decided who could enter the Club, commonly based on the disguises the prospective customers were wearing.

Sebaracca knew that a certain amount of criminal activities took place in her lounge &mdash; something unsurprising in a city like Depatar, known as one of the biggests black markets in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. She allowed it as long as she could collect a tenth of any amount changing hands.
